object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Read the outline of a document whose top-level heading has one sub-object. Then add a sub-object below that sub-object, another below that one, and a second top-level object, and read the outline again. Expected: the first read lists the heading at level 0 and its sub-object at level 1, each with its text; the second lists the heading, its sub-object, that one's sub-object, the next one down, then the second top-level object, with no count of objects left out.
